newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank allots SKK1.0bln in repos at 15.5pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank allots SKK1.0bln in repos at 15.5pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday said it had allocated funds totalling one billion crowns at this morning's securities repurchase tender at a rate of 15.5 percent.
In the NBS's last tender on Wednesday the average rate was 10.53 percent.
The NBS added that the total volume of all bids submitted for the tender was 3.2 billion crowns.
The NBS holds tenders on a daily basis if needed at 1000 CET (0900 GMT), instead of quoting securities repo and reverse repo rates.
